items.title: Browser search filters (date/text filter, scan in QThread with cancel)
items.where: glue-solar iris-observation-browser: glue_solar/sources/loaders/iris.py:205-211 (set_directory -> scan_directory synchronous), iris_loader.ui (only Folder/Change…/'Search subfolders'), glue_solar/sources/loaders/scan.py:118-179; reusable upstream: /Users/nabil/Git/glue-qt/glue_qt/utils/threading.py:8 (Worker(QThread) with result/error signals)
items.evidence: iris_loader.ui has no QLineEdit filter, no QDateEdit, no cancel-scan button (the 'cancel' button at loaders/iris.py:183 is dialog reject). set_directory() calls scan_directory() inline and populate() rebuilds the whole tree; no setHidden/filter anywhere (grep for filter/date/thread in loaders/iris.py: only a builtin filter() at line 90). scan_directory has no progress/stop hook (single for-loop at scan.py:137). glue-core site-packages has no threading helpers (grep empty); glue_qt has Worker (utils/threading.py), ComputeWorker (viewers/matplotlib/compute_worker.py) — no cancel API of their own, but QThread natively has requestInterruption()/isInterruptionRequested() (verified via dir(Worker)). Ran scan_directory through glue_qt Worker offscreen: result signal delivered 14 observations, no error. Timing on the user's real tree /Users/nabil/DATA/IRIS (140 files, 14 obs, 130 grouped files): 0.51 s, i.e. ~4 ms/file — blocking is only noticeable on mirror-scale trees (10k files ~ 40 s). Baseline tests: 23 passed (test_scan.py + test_importer.py). STARTOBS column is ISO text ('2014-03-29T14:09:38'), so a plain text filter already filters by date substring.
items.blockers: None. Cancellation needs a cooperative stop hook in scan_directory (e.g. `stop=lambda: False` kwarg checked in the file loop) — there is none today. Tree must be repopulated in the GUI thread from the Worker.result signal (Worker lives in the main thread, so queued connection is automatic). Recursive toggle (loaders/iris.py:186) and archive extraction (finalize -> set_directory at 281/284) both re-enter set_directory and must wait for / cancel a running worker.
items.recommendation: Ship the lazy version: one QLineEdit 'Filter' above the tree that setHidden()s top-level items whose STARTOBS/OBSID/Description text does not contain the string (covers '2014-03' style date filtering with zero extra widgets); add QDateEdit start/end only if someone asks. For the scan: wrap scan_directory in glue_qt.utils.Worker, add a `stop` callable kwarg to scan_directory wired to worker.isInterruptionRequested, and turn the progress bar busy + a 'Stop scan' button while running. ~40-60 lines plus two tests (filter hides rows; interrupted scan returns partial/empty list). Do not build a filename-pattern preset system.
items.doc_corrections: Plan §Phase 1 item 1 (line 62-66) says the QThread is needed 'so large trees do not block the dialog' — measured 0.51 s for a 140-file real tree; only mirror-scale trees (thousands of files) block noticeably. Plan does not name the existing glue_qt.utils.Worker it should reuse. Plan claims this 'closes the no time-range search half' of the audit row: iris_xfiles' tstartval/tstopval search walks a level2/yyyy/mm/dd mirror by date; a start/end filter applied after a full scan is post-filtering, not search — fine for glue, but the row stays Partial unless the wording is adjusted. Audit line 167 ('No time-range search, filename-pattern presets, recent search windows, search cancellation') is accurate for the branch.

items.title: Log files (list *.log per observation, read-only text dialog)
items.where: glue-solar iris-observation-browser: glue_solar/sources/loaders/scan.py:145 (`if not name.endswith(_FITS): continue`), Observation dataclass scan.py:54-73 (no logs field), loaders/iris.py:229-235 (tree entries: sji/raster/sdo/archive only)
items.evidence: scan.py:139 handles *.tar.gz, scan.py:145 drops every other non-FITS name, so *.log is skipped; conftest.py:90 writes 'notes.txt' only to prove non-FITS files are ignored; no .log in any fixture or test (grep '.log' in tests/conftest: none). Do Level 2 downloads ship .log? No: the LMSAL HCR download page for 20140329_140938_3860258481 (WebFetch) offers raster.tar.gz, SJI *.fits.gz (+deconvolved), movies.tar, SDO/SOTSP tar.gz, mp4s, science-timeline txt/gif and a VOEvent XML — no log. irispy test data (irispy.data.test.get_test_data_filenames: 29 files, only .fits/.sav/.geny/.pro/overview.txt) and the irispy pooch registry (/Users/nabil/Git/irispy/irispy/data/_sample.py:15-21) contain no .log. The user's own downloads /Users/nabil/DATA/IRIS and ~/Downloads/IRIS (140 files each) contain only FITS/tar.gz + .DS_Store. The .log is written by the SolarSoft level1to2 pipeline: irisl12_writelogfile.pro `file = filename + method + '.log'` with filename = `{level2dir}/iris_l2_{YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS}_{OBSID}` (iris_level1to2.pro), i.e. it exists only on mirrors that ran the pipeline locally (LMSAL/UiO). iris_xfiles (hesperia ssw/iris/idl/uio/ql/iris_xfiles.pro) has no log search at all: files matching the default filter 'iris_l2*' are listed, and a selected non-.fits file matching regex '.*log' is dumped by iris_xfiles_logdisplay into a widget_text(xs=160, ysize=50, /scroll) with a Close button. The existing _L2_STEM regex already keys such names: _key_from_name('iris_l2_20140329_140938_3860258481_raster.log') -> ('3860258481', '2014-03-29T14:09:38'). glue-qt has no reusable read-only text dialog (GlueLogger in glue_qt/app/application.py:90 is the stderr window; profile_tools.ui uses an inline QTextBrowser); native QPlainTextEdit(readOnly=True) in a QDialog is enough.
items.blockers: No real test data has a .log — the iris_tree fixture must synthesize one. Log entries must not flow through finalize()'s loader branch (loaders/iris.py:289-302); open them on double-click/context action instead of via 'Load selected'.
items.recommendation: Value is near zero for anyone using public downloads, irispy sample data, or pooch caches (none ship .log); only pipeline mirrors have them. Either drop it (YAGNI) or do it in the same PR as P1.1 since both touch the tree-entry code: add `logs: list[Path]` to Observation, accept `name.endswith('.log')` keyed by _key_from_name in scan_directory (~5 lines), list them as non-checkable children, and on double-click show the text in a QPlainTextEdit(readOnly) QDialog (~15 lines) plus one test with a synthetic .log. ~25-30 lines total.
items.doc_corrections: Plan line 36/90 and audit line 170 are correct that nothing is implemented, but neither says that IRIS Level 2 public downloads, irispy test/sample data and pooch caches contain no *.log files — they are level1to2 pipeline by-products (`iris_l2_<ts>_<obsid>[_raster|_sji].log`) present only on local mirrors, so 'trivial' is right on size but the feature has almost no users. Audit line 57 ('Internal iris_xfiles log window: shows the text contents of a selected log file') is accurate; note iris_xfiles has no dedicated log search or file-type entry — it only displays a picked file that matches '.*log'.

audit.notes: Both items are honestly 'not implemented' on the iris-observation-browser branch; nothing on the glue/glue-qt fork branches touches them. Combined size if both are done the lazy way: roughly 70-90 lines of code + 3 tests + a paragraph in docs/user_guide/loading-iris-level-2-raster-and-sji-data.rst. Recommended ordering: text filter first (biggest UX win, ~15 lines), Worker-threaded scan with cooperative stop second (only pays off on mirror-scale trees), .log listing last or dropped (no public data has them). Aside noticed while running code: importing glue_solar outside pytest fails with the user's ~/.glue settings ('Unit converter iris-velocity is not defined', glue/config.py:938) because glue_solar/__init__.py imports glue.config before the plugin registers the converter — I worked around it with HOME=<scratch>; not in my area but worth a look. All web probes to www.lmsal.com directory listings return 403; hesperia SSW mirror serves the IDL sources.

verdicts.evidence: Re-verified on iris-observation-browser (HEAD d3a2bd3): loaders/iris.py:205-211 set_directory() calls scan_directory() inline; iris_loader.ui widgets are only directory/change/recursive/obs_tree/progress/stack/cancel/ok (no QLineEdit filter, no QDateEdit, no stop button; 'cancel' at iris.py:183 is reject). scan.py:137 single for-loop, no stop hook. glue-core site-packages: no QThread/QRunnable anywhere. glue_qt (main, branch macos-integration has no diff there): glue_qt/utils/threading.py:8 Worker(QThread) exported from glue_qt.utils, viewers/matplotlib/compute_worker.py:15 ComputeWorker (start/end/error signals, no cancel); ran a Worker offscreen with QThread.currentThread().isInterruptionRequested() in the loop -> ('interrupted', 933707), so cooperative stop works with the existing Worker. Tests: 23 passed (test_scan.py + test_importer.py; needs -o addopts='' because pytest.ini's --doctest-rst is unrecognized without doctestplus loaded — reproduced). Timing re-run: /Users/nabil/DATA/IRIS 14 obs / 130 files / 0.50 s. Caveat the auditor understated: test_importer.py builds QtIRISImporter(tree) and reads the tree synchronously in 6 tests (lines 17-18, 52-56, 75, 82-86, 208-215, 225-241), and test_recursive_toggle_rescans / test_extract_archive_then_lists_its_windows re-enter set_directory, so an async scan means qtbot.waitUntil/waitSignal edits in ~6 existing tests or a synchronous fallback path — 'plus two tests' is optimistic; still small. Plan lines 62-66 wording and absence of any 'Worker' mention (grep count 0) confirmed; audit line 167 confirmed.

scan.py:139 handles *.tar.gz, scan.py:145 `if not name.endswith(_FITS): continue` drops .log; Observation (scan.py:54-73) has no logs field; conftest.py:90 writes only notes.txt; grep '.log' in conftest/tests: none. Public data has no .log — stronger evidence than the auditor's HCR page: the UiO public L2 archive listing is fetchable (HTTP 200) and http://sdc.uio.no/vol/fits/iris/level2/2014/03/29/20140329_140938_3860258481/ has 368 entries (183 .fits + 185 .gz), 20211001_060925_3683602040 18 entries, 20210905_001833_3620258102 12 entries — zero names containing 'log', no .txt/.xml either. irispy.data.test.get_test_data_filenames(): 31 names (.fits/.sav/.geny/.pro/overview.txt), no .log; pooch registry (_sample.py:15-21) no .log; three cached raster.tar.gz in ~/Library/Caches/pooch contain only .fits; /Users/nabil/DATA/IRIS and ~/Downloads/IRIS: 140 files each, only .DS_Store non-FITS. Pipeline origin confirmed at the correct path hesperia .../ssw/iris/idl/uio/level1to2/irisl12_writelogfile.pro line 29 `file = filename + method + '.log'` (method '' / '_sji' / '_raster'; also a `.errorlog` variant at line 9) and iris_level1to2.pro:600 `filename = level2dir+'iris_l2_'+time2file(OBSstart)+'_'+OBSid`; _key_from_name keys both 'iris_l2_..._raster.log' and '..._SJI_1400_t000.log' -> ('3860258481','2014-03-29T14:09:38'). iris_xfiles.pro (WebFetch): sfilters=['iris_l2*','*','*','*'], dsource=['IRIS','EIS/CCSDS','EIS/FITS','EIS/HK'] (no log mode); a selected non-.fits file matching stregex '.*log' goes to iris_xfiles_logdisplay (widget_text /scroll xs=160 ysize=50), otherwise 'FITS file must have .fits extension' — matches auditor. glue-qt: GlueLogger at app/application.py:90 (QTextEdit stderr window), profile_tools.ui QTextBrowser, report_*.ui QPlainTextEdit — no standalone read-only text dialog. 'Trivial' sizing holds; if implemented, match '.errorlog' too (iris_xfiles' '.*log' regex does).

verify.summary: Both verdicts stand: P1.1 and P1.7 are not implemented on iris-observation-browser, nothing on the glue/glue-qt fork branches touches them, and the cited file:line references, upstream helpers (glue_qt.utils.Worker, no cancel API but QThread interruption works cooperatively — reproduced), test results (23 passed) and timing (0.50 s for 130 files) all reproduce. Additions/corrections to the auditor's report: (1) P1.1 size understated on the test side — six existing test_importer.py tests construct the dialog and read the tree synchronously, and the recursive-toggle and extract-archive tests re-enter set_directory, so a QThread scan means ~6 test edits (qtbot.waitUntil) or a synchronous path kept for tests; code size (~40-60 lines) is fair. (2) P1.7 'no public .log' claim is now backed by a public archive listing, not just the HCR page: sdc.uio.no level2 directories for three observations (368/18/12 files) contain zero log files; pooch tarballs contain only .fits. The pipeline source is at ssw/iris/idl/uio/level1to2/ (auditor's path was vague/404 elsewhere) and also emits '.errorlog', which an implementation should accept alongside '.log'. (3) The auditor's aside that 'importing glue_solar outside pytest fails with Unit converter iris-velocity' is NOT reproducible: `import glue_solar`, the importer module and glue_solar.sources.iris all import fine with the real HOME; ~/.glue/settings.cfg has unit_converter = "default" and no 'iris-velocity' string exists in glue_solar or ~/.glue — treat that aside as stale. Doc corrections in the report (plan 62-66 blocking claim, missing Worker mention, 'Partial' row wording; audit 57/167/170 accurate) are correct.
